notes: Fix: a Basic Item Vacuum, Chunk Loader, Mob Repeller or Lava Pump no longer shows an empty Range slot that refuses chips. Range Chips start at Steel, so on a Basic machine the slot shows as closed ("Range Chips: Steel tier needed") until you use a Steel Machine Upgrade, and a Range Chip dropped on its screen comes back with that reason. Also in this build (4.45.x): network ordering, first test build. Network Cable joins crates, the Deepcore Chest, terminals and machines to a Network Core. Order from a Network Crafter: tap an item, then Make an amount or Keep an amount stocked; the network plans the steps and sends each one to a machine on the cable. Order Processors run orders (each powered one runs one at a time). The On demand tab is gone, and the Network Terminal has a sort button.
